title: Firm benchmark: demand growth behind successful hospital openings
text: Across 9 private hospital openings in secondary East African cities, the ones that reached target occupancy were in markets where inpatient demand grew 8 to 10% a year. Method: review of project files and county data. Sample data (simulated).

title: County health statistics: inpatient bed-days, Nakuru
text: Inpatient bed-days in private and faith-based hospitals in Nakuru County grew 9.8% a year between 2021 and 2025. Figures are compiled from facility returns to the county health department. Sample data (simulated).

title: Private hospital demand to grow 10 to 12% a year, says outlook (Daily Nation)
text: Demand for private inpatient care in Nakuru will grow 10 to 12% a year to 2030, according to the HealthMarket Kenya Outlook 2026. Sample data (simulated).

title: Hospitals can't find nurses, says a forum post
text: A forum post says no new hospital in Nakuru will find nurses for years. No source is given. Sample data (simulated).

title: Nurse shortages slow new hospitals
text: Hospital managers say hiring enough nurses for a new hospital now takes about 12 months. Several openings were delayed last year. Sample data (simulated).

title: Firm case review: nurse recruitment for hospital openings
text: Across three hospital openings in Kenya, full nursing teams were recruited in 6 to 8 months. Method: review of project plans and HR records. Sample data (simulated).

title: Firm market note: insurance cover in secondary cities
text: In secondary Kenyan cities, 55 to 65% of private-hospital patients had insurance cover in 2025. Method: survey of 14 hospitals. Sample data (simulated).

title: HealthMarket Kenya Outlook 2026
source_name: Simulated health market database · Simulated source (prototype)
text: We forecast that demand for private inpatient care in Nakuru will grow 10 to 12% a year from 2025 to 2030. Method: facility-level model calibrated on county returns. Sample data (simulated).

title: New hospital occupancy in the first three years
source_name: Simulated health market database · Simulated source (prototype)
text: New private hospitals of 100 to 200 beds in Kenya averaged 68% bed occupancy in their third year. Method: returns from 11 hospitals opened since 2018. Sample data (simulated).

title: Expert call: hospital HR director
text: Hiring a full nursing team for a 150-bed hospital in Nakuru usually takes 8 to 10 months. It is faster if you start before construction ends. Sample data (simulated).
